name: loggercf
description: Structured logging and trace propagation for Cloudflare Workers and Node.js.

scripts.typecheck:dev: tsc --noEmit -p dev/main-worker && tsc --noEmit -p dev/bind-worker && tsc --noEmit -p dev/math-worker
scripts.dev:deploy: wrangler deploy -c dev/main-worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c dev/bind-worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c dev/math-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf-typegen: wrangler types -c dev/main-worker/wrangler.jsonc dev/main-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false && wrangler types -c dev/bind-worker/wrangler.jsonc dev/bind-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false && wrangler types -c dev/math-worker/wrangler.jsonc dev/math-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.release:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:dev && pnpm check:skill && pnpm test && pnpm pack:dry && pnpm e2e:local
